items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free style cleanser with no active ingredients is all a young face needs for washing morning and night.
A mineral SPF 50 fluid gives simple daytime sun protection that suits young skin.

response.routine_note: Wash your face gently with lukewarm water once or twice a day, and apply the sunscreen in the morning before going outside. Skip strong actives, scrubs and peels at this age, and ask a parent or a doctor if you have any concerns about your skin.
